column3: Waiting to be noticed? The people who would help you can't see how hard it is to ask.
Nami's whole village knew what she was carrying. Robin's crew came all that way for her. But both of them still had to say the words.
In one study, student advisors expected about thirteen classmates to come to them for help. Fewer than eight did.
So they wait. And you wait. And nothing happens.
The door is usually open. But someone has to knock.
